sentences.text: It is stated that due to various differences, disputes and issues had arisen between the petitioners and the respondent no. 2.
Upon the complaint by respondent no. 2, the present FIR came to be registered against the petitioners.

It is stated that with intervention of the family and friends, the parties have now amicably settled their dispute vide Settlement Deed dated 15.02.2025 wherein it has been clearly mentioned that the minor daughter namely "Ganishka" shall remain in permanent and absolute care and custody of the petitioner no. 1 with no visitation rights on behalf of respondent no. 2 and respondent no. 2 states that she has no objection with the same.

5. On a query made by this Court, respondent no. 2 who has been identified by the IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat and is well aware of the terms and conditions of the Settlement Deed dated 15.02.2025.
Therefore, she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
6. In view of the above, that the parties have amicably resolved their differences of their own free will, and without any coercion, no useful purpose will be served by continuing the proceedings

,
rather the same would create further acrimony between them.
It would thus be in interest of justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
There is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.

7. Accordingly, FIR bearing No. 448/2023, registered at Police Station Ashok Vihar, Delhi, for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 354/377/406/498A/34 of IPC and all consequential proceedings This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 08/07/2025 at 22:05:43 emanating therefrom are quashed.
8. Accordingly, the petition stands disposed of.
9. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J JULY 07, 2025/
